diagnosis.what_happened: The writer introduced hyperbolic prose under word-count pressure when the orchestrator demanded narrative expansion.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Under volume expansion pressure without sufficient empirical grounding, the writer resorted to emotional padding and inflated dramatic rhetoric.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: The text should maintain strict academic sobriety with zero emotional hyperbole, regardless of length requirements.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Academic writing requires objective, neutral, and sober prose. Emotional hyperbole and dramatic rhetoric undermine the scientific credibility of the research.

desired_behavior: Maintain strict academic sobriety and neutral academic prose. Do not use emotional, dramatic, or hyperbolic wording to inflate word counts.
generalization: Academic writing must remain sober and neutral; zero tolerance for inflated dramatic prose.

evidence.observed_value: Defective dramatic prose observed under word-count pressure.
